topic: Data retention policy for project charts
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on the necessity and amount of historical data (charts) to retain for various projects. Initially, [p3] asked if it was possible to delete all charts except perhaps the last five for each project. Several participants agreed that older history was unnecessary.

*   [me] suggested retaining the last four records instead of five, citing a more 'programmer-friendly' approach.
*   [p1] advocated for minimal retention, stating that only the current or previous version is relevant, and anything before that is unimportant. 
*   Ultimately, [p3] proposed a simpler solution: keeping only the charts currently installed.
decisions: Retain only the charts currently installed on the system.
